templateContract.runtimePolicy: expand core and approved extension items into one frozen section-instance model; render, patch, validate, complete, query and compare through the same model without rereading the current template
forbidden: remove or rename a core section
make PROJECT_BACKGROUND, PROJECT_OBJECTIVE or NETWORK_TOPOLOGY optional
runtime add, delete, reorder, type change or schema designer
dictionaryVersion invented outside the public SYSTEM API

sol_preparation_forward_extension.purpose: reuse the SDS Preparation root for PRE-04 version lifecycle without changing PRE-02 current/readiness semantics
markerRules: PRE_02 uses existing current_marker only and draft_marker/effective_marker are NULL
PRE_04 uses draft_marker/effective_marker only and current_marker is NULL
PRE_04 DRAFT has draft_marker=1 and effective_marker=NULL
PRE_04 current effective COMPLETED has effective_marker=1 and draft_marker=NULL
PRE_04 historical COMPLETED has both markers NULL
sol_preparation_forward_extension.contentVersionPolicy: PRE_04 starts at 0, increments with each successful draft content/file mutation, freezes at completion and is not changed when effective_marker is later cleared; PRE_02 keeps it NULL
sol_preparation_forward_extension.pre02Compatibility: existing readiness columns, status codes, indexes and current_marker contract remain unchanged
sol_preparation_forward_extension.pre04ReadinessColumns: readiness-specific fields are not exposed or consumed for PRE-04 and retain neutral storage defaults; they never define PRE-04 completion or SCH readiness

sol_requirement_analysis_section.purpose: one frozen PRE-04 core or extension section inside one preparation business version

fileBusinessKey.referenceKey: non-empty UUID slotKey; one stable slot per attachment intent inside one section

fileActionMatrix.completedMutationPolicy: UPLOAD, REFERENCE, REPLACE and DETACH fail closed

sol_requirement_analysis_section.savedTruth: SOL value_snapshot and attachment_reference_snapshot are the only saved body and attachment facts for this business version
sol_requirement_analysis_section.currentPltReferenceSet: only FileReferences in ACTIVE state under the exact section SECTION_ATTACHMENT namespace are current; DETACHED and ARCHIVED are excluded
sol_requirement_analysis_section.pendingAttachmentPolicy: a difference between the current PLT ACTIVE set and the SOL attachment_reference_snapshot is recoverable pending submission, never an implicitly saved attachment fact
sol_requirement_analysis_section.scopeVersionSource: PROJ ProjectScope.treeVersion; one locked section set has one common scopeVersion copied into every frozen attachment fact; SOL section/root CAS and contentVersion never create or increment scopeVersion
sol_requirement_analysis_section.immutability: COMPLETED section content and file facts have stable query only; the root may only clear effective_marker when a later version completes

stateAxes.forbidden: one current marker that makes a new draft replace the still-effective completed input

stateMachine.initialize: no PRE-04 rows -> create businessVersion=1 DRAFT with draft_marker=1
stateMachine.firstComplete: DRAFT -> COMPLETED; clear draft_marker and set effective_marker=1 atomically
stateMachine.createNextDraft: copy current effective COMPLETED to businessVersion+1 DRAFT with source_preparation_id and draft_marker=1; old effective remains unchanged
stateMachine.completeNextDraft: lock expected draft and current effective; validate and revalidate files; clear old effective marker; change draft to COMPLETED, clear draft marker and set effective marker in one transaction
stateMachine.completedImmutability: no command updates or deletes COMPLETED section/content/file/completion facts; only the later-completion transaction may clear the old root effective_marker

dynamicFormValueSemantics.unifiedProcessing: core and extension sections share the same value snapshot, PATCH presence, validation, history and compare pipeline while core invariants remain immutable
dynamicFormValueSemantics.richTextRequired: sanitize first, then remove markup, decode entities and remove non-visible whitespace including non-breaking and zero-width characters; visible text must remain non-empty
dynamicFormValueSemantics.selectionRequired: required SINGLE_SELECT must match one frozen option; required MULTI_SELECT must be non-empty and every value must match the frozen optionSnapshot

attachmentSynchronization.patchPolicy: when the attachment field is present, treat it as the complete intended set; after PROJ and SOL locks, lock the exact current set under the F-PLT-001 batch two-phase contract, normalize by full business key plus artifactId/versionNo/fileFactVersion/scopeVersion, and require equality with the submitted vector before any SOL CAS
attachmentSynchronization.scopeVersionPolicy: the section Provider obtains collection scopeVersion only from PROJ ProjectScope.treeVersion; PATCH writes that same locked collection scopeVersion into every frozen fact, and later COMPLETE may revalidate it unchanged when no external scope/file fact changed
attachmentSynchronization.completePolicy: flatten every section attachment snapshot, lock all section current sets under the F-PLT-001 batch two-phase contract, and require every PLT ACTIVE set to equal its SOL snapshot before any completion CAS
attachmentSynchronization.lockOrderReference: F-PLT-001 batch two-phase contract: lock and revalidate all stably sorted business Providers first; then acquire all stably sorted PLT Artifact -> Version -> Reference locks; no Provider callback after the first PLT lock
attachmentSynchronization.differencePolicy: set difference, unknown fact or Provider failure blocks PATCH/COMPLETE but leaves the latest SOL snapshot unchanged and exposes a recoverable pending state
attachmentSynchronization.responseUnknownRetry: retain the original slot keys, intended attachment vector and command intent; reload SOL and PLT, recover success when SOL already equals the intended vector, otherwise retry that same intent after refreshing CAS facts without generating replacement slot keys

sectionResponse.statusSemantics: IN_SYNC means authoritative current ACTIVE facts equal the SOL snapshot; PENDING means known sets differ; UNKNOWN means Provider or scope facts are unavailable
sectionResponse.savedAttachments: always project only the SOL attachment snapshot as saved attachments
sectionResponse.managerRecoveryFields: only the current manager viewing the current editable draft receives currentActiveFacts sorted by referenceKey plus stable attachmentSyncErrorCode; IN_SYNC/PENDING returns the complete vector including [] for an empty set, UNKNOWN returns currentActiveFacts=null; error codes are null/ATTACHMENT_SET_PENDING/FACT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE respectively
sectionResponse.readOnlyPolicy: all other readers receive no currentActiveFacts and no differing PLT set as attachments; raw Provider errors are never exposed

attachmentSynchronization.navigationPolicy: a PLT/SOL attachment difference blocks section/version navigation and COMPLETE until the current editable-draft manager submits the returned complete currentActiveFacts vector to the current section and PATCH succeeds; there is no implicit cancel command that rewrites PLT. Local body-only dirty state may be explicitly discarded only while attachments are IN_SYNC; refresh preserves and displays authoritative pending state

completionBlockers.projectionPolicy: derive from the current SOL snapshot and read-only authoritative facts; never expose raw Provider exceptions
completionBlockers.allowedActionPolicy: project COMPLETE only when blockers are empty and every required fact is known

transactions.createDraft: LOCK_AND_REVALIDATE_PROJECT_MANAGER; LOCK_CURRENT_EFFECTIVE_DRAFT_MARKER_AND_SECTIONS; VALIDATE_IF_MATCH_AND_NO_EXISTING_DRAFT; INSERT_NEW_ROOT_AND_SECTIONS; LOCK_ALL_SOURCE_READ_AND_TARGET_REFERENCE_PROVIDERS_IN_STABLE_KEY_ORDER; LOCK_ALL_PLT_ARTIFACT_VERSION_REFERENCE_FACTS_IN_STABLE_ORDER_AND_ATTACH_TARGETS; INSERT_DRAFT_MARKER; IDEMPOTENCY_SUCCESS; AUDIT; ALL_IN_ONE_TRANSACTION
transactions.complete: LOCK_PROJECT_AND_CURRENT_MANAGER; LOCK_EXPECTED_DRAFT_CURRENT_EFFECTIVE_AND_ALL_SECTIONS; VALIDATE_REQUIRED_AND_FROZEN_SCHEMA; FLATTEN_ALL_SECTION_ATTACHMENT_SETS; LOCK_ALL_BUSINESS_PROVIDERS_THEN_ALL_PLT_ARTIFACT_VERSION_REFERENCE_FACTS_PER_F_PLT_001_BATCH_TWO_PHASE_CONTRACT; REQUIRE_EVERY_ACTIVE_SET_EQUALS_SOL_SNAPSHOT_AND_REVALIDATE_ALL_EXACT_FILE_FACTS; CLEAR_OLD_EFFECTIVE_MARKER; CAS_DRAFT_TO_COMPLETED_AND_SWITCH_MARKERS; IDEMPOTENCY_SUCCESS; AUDIT

queryResponseFields: sections[].currentActiveFacts[] (current editable draft manager only; sorted by referenceKey)
sections[].attachmentSyncErrorCode (current editable draft manager only; stable code)
interfaces.patchAttachmentVectorPolicy: when present, attachments are the complete intended set and may be frozen only after equality with the locked PLT ACTIVE set

publicRequirementAnalysisApi.authorization: trusted actor must hold pms:requirement-analysis:query and pass PROJ PROJECT_VIEW scope before SOL or PLT facts are returned or locked
publicRequirementAnalysisApi.readOnlyPolicy: inspect and lockAndRevalidate write no PRE-04, SCH or PLT business facts
publicRequirementAnalysisApi.consumerPolicy: future SCH-01 stores the selected preparationId and businessVersion and owns prefill, input-difference and solution-version behavior
publicRequirementAnalysisApi.historicalPolicy: an explicit historical COMPLETED version remains readable and lockable with isCurrentEffective=false and current effective identifiers; F-SOL-003 does not decide SCH input-difference handling
publicRequirementAnalysisApi.unknownPolicy: missing, cross-tenant, DRAFT, non-COMPLETED, invalid file or any expected content/project/template fact change fails closed

platformFileReferenceCommand.purpose: create independent target FileReferences that reuse already committed immutable FileVersions without re-upload

lockAndWritePolicy.phase1BusinessProviders: sort every source READ and target REFERENCE request by ownerContext,objectType,objectId,purposeCode,referenceKey,action and lockAndRevalidate all providers before any PLT lock
lockAndWritePolicy.phase2PlatformLocks: sort all artifacts by artifactId, versions by artifactId/versionNo and references by full stable key; acquire every PLT lock in Artifact -> Version -> Reference order; never call a business provider after the first PLT lock
lockAndWritePolicy.targetSlot: after its exact reference lock: insert an independent ACTIVE FileReference when absent, replay when the same target key already points to the same artifact/version, conflict when it points elsewhere
lockAndWritePolicy.sourceFact: after locks compare every expected artifact/reference/availability/scope version and fail closed on change

platformFileReferenceCommand.batchContractReuse: PATCH and COMPLETE attachment-set locking must reuse the same F-PLT-001 two-phase ordering rule: every business Provider lock first, then all Artifact -> Version -> Reference PLT locks, with no Provider callback after the first PLT lock
platformFileReferenceCommand.replayPolicy: same target full key already pointing to the same artifact/version returns its current fact; a target key pointing to a different version conflicts
platformFileReferenceCommand.atomicity: joins the caller transaction; all target references and the SOL draft/sections commit or roll back together
forbidden: reuse the source full business key
mutate or detach the source COMPLETED reference
re-upload the same bytes as a substitute
return file body, storage key or URL

dependencies.projectParticipantAndScope: consume ProjectParticipantFactApi and ProjectScopeApi; roles do not imply descendant scope
dependencies.fileArtifact: consume F-PLT-001 exact reference inspect/lockAndRevalidate, attachExistingVersions and access-ticket APIs; SOL stores no body, URL or infra fact
dependencies.solution: future SCH-01 consumes publicRequirementAnalysisApi; F-SOL-003 writes no Solution or reference row
dependencies.events: SOL publishes no domain event; the PLT attach command retains its existing FileReferenceAttached event; the approved inter-context call boundary is synchronous

permissions.frontendBackendTruth: server projects allowedActions and revalidates trusted tenant, function, ProjectStageScope, current subject, state, version and completionBlockers; COMPLETE is absent when any blocker exists or an authoritative fact is unknown

platformFacts.idempotencyPolicy: COMPLETED plus same digest replays the stored response; same key plus different digest conflicts; Decision.IN_PROGRESS has null response and maps to stable PMS-PLATFORM-COMMAND-IN-PROGRESS with no success side effect
platformFacts.fileFacts: exact FileArtifact version and reference only
platformFacts.richTextAuditPolicy: audit controlled before/after summaries and identifiers, never copy sensitive full body or attachment content

dictionarySnapshot.publishValidation: selection extension dictionary and every selected option must be enabled
dictionarySnapshot.runtimePolicy: SOL validates values only against the frozen optionSnapshot

legacy.policy: existing backend, frontend, CRUD, status, menu definitions and data remain unchanged; no PRE-04 current truth, migration, dual write or inferred completion

permissionRetirement.mechanism: forward initialization configuration deletes system_role_menu associations only
permissionRetirement.target: the complete legacy requirement-analysis menu tree plus every legacy button menu carrying pms:eng-requirement:*
permissionRetirement.removeFrom: all roles except the built-in super_admin role
preserve: legacy backend, frontend, CRUD, status and data
forbidden: delete role, menu or legacy data
change legacy code or state machine
grant PRE-04 permissions through a legacy menu association

reusableSlices: Yudao and Element Plus editor patterns

seedRequirements: PRE-04 catalogVersion=1 and eleven core section labels
representative project WorkBinding configurations for no extension, multiple extension field types and disabled dictionary rejection

remove system_role_menu associations for every non-built-in-super_admin role and the complete legacy requirement-analysis menu tree including every button carrying pms:eng-requirement:* while preserving menu records and built-in super_admin access

acceptanceAddendum.AC-FSOL003-014: PRE-04 is one template-driven dynamic form instance containing the eleven immutable core sections plus approved extensions; the draft freezes full structure, type, required, order and optionSnapshot, uses one processing pipeline, ignores later template changes, and exposes no runtime schema designer or field mutation entry
acceptanceAddendum.AC-FSOL003-015: SOL remains the only saved body and attachment truth; every section projects IN_SYNC, PENDING or UNKNOWN, only the current editable-draft manager receives referenceKey-sorted complete currentActiveFacts plus a stable error code, DETACHED and ARCHIVED are non-current, retry retains original slots and intent, and a difference can be resolved only by successfully PATCHing that complete ACTIVE vector; there is no undefined cancel command to rewrite PLT
acceptanceAddendum.AC-FSOL003-016: legacy requirement-analysis backend, frontend, CRUD, status, menus and data remain unchanged and are not PRE-04 truth; forward permission configuration removes every legacy menu and pms:eng-requirement:* button system_role_menu association from all non-built-in-super_admin roles while preserving the menu records and built-in super_admin access
